newsitem.title: USA: Vitol SA delivered 892,000 bbls of Bonny Light.
newsitem.headline: Vitol SA delivered 892,000 bbls of Bonny Light.

text.p: Vitol S.A. Inc delivered 892,000 barrels of Nigerian Bonny Light against the May NYMEX crude contract, a trade source familiar with the firm's trading operations said on Thursday.
A total of 2.73 million barrels of foreign crude were delivered against the NYMEX this month, out of total record delivery of 6.621 million barrels.
Foreign deliveries into the NYMEX are unusual because they are normally uneconomic and considered the option of last resort for sellers.
Vitol is a privately owned Swiss company.
